caption: The drawing depicts a single garment, specifically a corset-style bodice, laid flat against a neutral beige or cream background. The bodice is rendered in soft, muted tones of light gray, off-white, and hints of tan with delicate shading that reveals its folds, seams, buttons, and embroidery details. Each side features five round gold or brass-colored buttons, and the bodice has two broad shoulder straps. The lower edge of the bodice is scalloped, and the front showcases a symmetrical arrangement of stitched patterns, including vertical lines, diamonds, hearts, and other geometric and decorative motifs. There is subtle shadowing beneath the bodice to suggest its three-dimensionality. The drawing is finely detailed, focusing solely on the garment, with no other objects or background elements present except for a small printed label or artist’s signature below the corset.
title: Corset
